answer: The island schedule is applied in copper and ridge shows each instalment. A payout is split and therefore 30% arrives at settlement and the rest over 13 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An farming party therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4410 identities would post 754 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
